videos.title: Django Reinhardt - Gypsy With A Song
videos.description:
Django Reinhardt - Gypsy With A Song
From The Album: Jazz Guitar Virtuoso

Django Reinhardt was the first European Jazz musician to influence musicians back in the United States. He was born Jan 23, 1910 in Belgium, and grew up in a Gypsy camp near Paris.
